text: {"name":"rf_tx_config_update","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Applies the selected record’s per-path RF transmit settings and handles a deferred update for its associated RF context.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"record_index","v1":"record_base","v2":"record","v3":"rf_context_index","v5":"tx_config_table","v6":"path_loop_index","v7":"path_index","v10":"rf_context_base","v11":"rf_context","v25":"pending_record_index","v27":"pending_record","v30":"notification_message"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":34,"meaning":"Index selecting the associated RF context record."},{"offset":35,"meaning":"Small identifier associated with this record; checked against the 0–31 range."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Pending/state flag cleared when the deferred notification is queued."},{"offset":584,"meaning":"Start of a group of five per-path RF transmit configuration entries, each spaced 8 bytes apart."},{"offset":624,"meaning":"Start of a second group of five per-path RF transmit configuration entries, each spaced 8 bytes apart."},{"offset":106,"meaning":"RF-context active/enabled flag."},{"offset":107,"meaning":"Value used to derive the pending record index."},{"offset":234,"meaning":"Countdown decremented before processing the deferred update."}]}
